verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's developer docs show clear API versioning mechanics (REST API version header, Events API v2 vs v1, V3 webhooks) confirming multiple versioned endpoints, but no explicit documented deprecation policy or sunset timeline is cited. A community report also notes confusion distinguishing Events API v1 vs v2 keys, suggesting versioning transitions aren't always smooth. missing for 10: explicit deprecation-policy documentation, evidence of version sunset timelines, and confirmation the versioning confusion has been resolved.
